entries.task_id: seven|days|after the being intent on awakening is born
entries.description: Seven days after the being intent on awakening is born
entries.subject: Seven
entries.object: after the being intent on awakening is born

spans.text: Sammukhā metaṁ, bhante, bhagavato sutaṁ, sammukhā paṭiggahitaṁ: I have learned this in the presence of the Buddha: ‘sattāhajāte, ānanda, bodhisatte bodhisattamātā kālaṁ karoti, tusitaṁ kāyaṁ upapajjatī’ti. ‘Seven days after the being intent on awakening is born, his mother passes away and is reborn in the host of joyful gods.’

spans.text: Suppose a jewel-treasure was placed on a cloth from Kāsi.
